content.text: In the credit_card_fraud_pipeline, the variable `suspicious` should be renamed to `suspicious_df` to follow the project convention of suffixing DataFrame variables with `_df`. This improves code readability and makes it immediately clear that the variable holds a pandas DataFrame. No functional changes are required — this is a pure rename refactor.

All occurrences of the variable `suspicious` in the credit_card_fraud_pipeline are renamed to `suspicious_df`. The pipeline runs successfully with no errors after the rename. No other variable names or logic are changed.
